title.value: Universality of Linear Recurrences Followed by Non-linear Projections: Finite-Width Guarantees and Benefits of Complex Eigenvalues
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the paper's investigation into the capabilities of linear recurrences followed by non-linear projections and their theoretical guarantees, particularly emphasizing the role of complex eigenvalues.
title.quote: Universality of Linear Recurrences Followed by Non-linear Projections: Finite-Width Guarantees and Benefits of Complex Eigenvalues

analysis.description: This research paper explores the expressive power of deep learning models that utilize linear recurrent neural networks (RNNs) interleaved with multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) for sequence modeling. It establishes theoretical guarantees for these architectures, particularly when incorporating complex eigenvalues in the linear RNNs. The paper discusses the universality of this architecture in approximating regular causal sequence-to-sequence maps and provides insights into their performance and initialization strategies.

type.justification: The paper primarily focuses on theoretical aspects, such as establishing the universal approximation capabilities of linear RNNs combined with MLPs and the benefits of complex eigenvalues.
type.quote: In this paper, we step back and study the theoretical expressivity of models based on stacks of vanilla linear complex-valued RNNs interleaved with position-wise MLPs.

name.justification: The paper focuses on sequence models like linear RNNs and state-space models for sequence-to-sequence tasks.
